meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任何文本背后的思维模式与认知风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从文字中读懂一个人的思考方式
copy.tagline_en: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand how someone thinks from their writing

howto.what: 分析任何文本作者的思维模式，从12个维度（如分析深度、创造力等）打分，并生成认知档案，包括主导模式、推理拓扑和决策指纹。
howto.when: 当你提供一段文本，并希望了解作者的思考方式、认知风格，或说出“分析这个人的推理”、“认知档案”、“思维模式”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字的思维模式。
say.note: 对提供的文本进行认知档案分析。

say.text: 比较这两篇文章的认知风格。
say.note: 对两篇或多篇文本进行对比分析。
基于当前对话历史分析你的认知特征。

howto.what_en: Analyzes any text to extract the author's cognitive patterns, scoring 12 dimensions (e.g., analytical depth, creativity) and generating a profile including dominant pattern, reasoning topology, and decision fingerprint.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text and want to understand how someone thinks, or when you use keywords like "analyze reasoning", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", or "digital DNA".

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text.
say_en.note: Generates a cognitive profile for the provided text.

say_en.text: Compare the cognitive styles of these two articles.
say_en.note: Produces individual profiles and a comparison synthesis.
Profiles your own thinking based on the conversation history.
